get.summary: The signed-in user. Also issues the anti-forgery token cookie for later unsafe requests.
The workspaces the current user is a member of, by name.
get.description: Only workspaces the user may open are listed: a workspace that would answer 404 to GET is never in the list.

post.summary: Create a workspace; the creator becomes its first Workspace Admin.
post.description: Needs Installation.ManageWorkspaces and an MFA session (ADR-015 D3.6).

post.summary: Parse query-language text and return its AST, normalized form and positioned errors.
post.description: Also checks saved-search references (savedsearch:<savedSearchId>): each must be a saved search you can see, and nested saved searches must not form a loop (SAVED_SEARCH_NOT_FOUND, SAVED_SEARCH_CYCLE, SAVED_SEARCH_TOO_DEEP, SAVED_SEARCH_INVALID, SAVED_SEARCH_INVALID_REFERENCE); errors inside a referenced search point at the reference.

post.summary: Run a query-language search and return its first page of post-filtered results.
post.description: Hits are re-checked against current access rights before the page is returned (restricted and walled documents are omitted). Totals above 10,000 are lower bounds unless countExact is set; counts and facets are approximate while the index catches up (freshness).

get.summary: Another page of a search: by cursor (next/previous), page number near the top, or the last page.
get.description: Give exactly one of cursor, page or last=true. Searches expire after inactivity (404).

get.summary: How current the workspace's search index is: current, updating or delayed, with the generation watermark.
get.description: indexedThroughGeneration is refresh-aware: every change committed with a generation at or below it is searchable. pendingChanges counts committed changes not yet searchable; lagSeconds is the age of the oldest of them. Cheap to poll.

get.summary: The caller's recent queries in the workspace: distinct, newest first, at most 50.

post.summary: Record a query the caller ran; re-running a query moves it to the top.
post.description: The query must parse (see query-validations); surrounding whitespace is trimmed and empty queries are rejected.

get.summary: Every saved-search folder of the workspace, ordered by name.

post.summary: Create a folder (top level, or below parentFolderId).

put.summary: Rename or move a folder (If-Match required). Its creator or a Workspace Admin may change it.

delete.summary: Delete an empty folder (409 FOLDER_NOT_EMPTY otherwise). If-Match is honoured when sent.

get.summary: The saved searches you can see (yours, shared with you or a group of yours; all as Workspace Admin), by name.
get.description: folderId narrows to one folder (folderId=root: searches outside any folder); q matches names (case-insensitive). Each entry carries its owner, sharing, and the time, hit count and freshness of its last run.

post.summary: Save a search: query text (validated now, re-parsed at every run), columns, sort and folder. Private until shared.

get.summary: Users and IdP groups of the workspace you can share a saved search with (needs SavedSearch.Share).
get.description: Users with a role in the workspace (directly or through one of their groups) and the IdP groups that hold a role, except yourself, by display name; q matches names and e-mail addresses (case-insensitive); limit 1–500, default 50.

get.summary: A saved search with its criteria and ETag.

put.summary: Replace a saved search's name, folder, criteria, columns and sort (If-Match required; owner or Workspace Admin).

delete.summary: Delete a saved search (If-Match required; owner or Workspace Admin).

post.summary: Copy a saved search you can see as a new private search of yours.

put.summary: Replace the users and IdP groups a saved search is shared with (owner or Workspace Admin; needs SavedSearch.Share).
put.description: Sharing never grants document access: whoever runs the search sees only documents they may see. If-Match is honoured when sent.

get.summary: The document-list views you can see: every shared view and your own (all as Workspace Admin), shared first, by name.

post.summary: Save a view (columns and up to 3 sort fields). Personal by default; a shared view needs View.ManageShared.

get.summary: Your document-list layout in this workspace: the view you last used and your unsaved adjustments to it.

put.summary: Remember your document-list layout in this workspace (view, columns, sort).

get.summary: A view with its ETag.

put.summary: Replace a view (If-Match required). Personal: its owner or a Workspace Admin; shared, or changing visibility: View.ManageShared.

delete.summary: Delete a view (If-Match required). Personal: its owner or a Workspace Admin; shared: View.ManageShared.

get.summary: Every Highlight Set of the workspace by name, with the colour palette.

post.summary: Create a Highlight Set: name, colour and terms (HighlightSet.Manage; audited).
post.description: Each term is a word, "phrase", wildcard (at least 3 letters before * or ?), W/n proximity or an OR of these; several unquoted words are a phrase. Invalid terms answer 400 with errors keyed terms[i].expression.

get.summary: A Highlight Set with its ETag.

put.summary: Replace a Highlight Set's name, colour and terms (If-Match required; HighlightSet.Manage; audited).

delete.summary: Delete a Highlight Set (If-Match required; HighlightSet.Manage; audited).

get.summary: Your highlighting toggles in this workspace: the sets you switched off and whether search hits show.

put.summary: Store your highlighting toggles in this workspace (last write wins; not audited).

get.summary: The workspace's restriction classes with the roles that may see them and the coding choices that apply them.

put.summary: Create or replace a restriction class (If-Match when it exists; audited).
put.description: Documents coded with any of the rules' choices carry the class from the commit on; documents that no longer qualify lose it. Changing the grant of a role you hold answers 403 self-protection (ADR-015 D6.5).

delete.summary: Delete a workspace-defined restriction class; its documents lose it (If-Match; audited). Built-in classes answer 409.

get.summary: The workspace's ethical walls with members and scope (documents you may not see are left out).

post.summary: Create an ethical wall: covered documents are hidden from its members on every path from the commit on (audited).
post.description: A wall that names you (directly or through a group) answers 403 self-protection: another administrator must create it.

get.summary: An ethical wall with its ETag.

put.summary: Replace an ethical wall's name, members and scope (If-Match; audited; never a wall that names you).

delete.summary: Delete an ethical wall (If-Match; audited; never a wall that names you).

get.summary: Field-level restrictions: which roles see and edit each restricted custom field.

put.summary: Restrict a custom field to roles (If-Match when restricted already; audited).
put.description: Principals holding none of visibleTo do not see the field anywhere (metadata, coding, layouts, search fields, result columns, exports, productions); principals holding none of editableBy see it read-only.

get.summary: The break-glass report (Audit.Read: every activation, newest first) or your own activations.

post.summary: Open break-glass access: read-only (view, search, audit) past restriction classes and walls for 1–240 minutes (default 60).
post.description: Needs a BreakGlass role assignment, a stated reason and an MFA step-up (Q-45). The activation and every action during it are audited with access path BreakGlass. 409 while one is open.

post.summary: End your open activation, or revoke another user's with Workspace.ManageSecurity (audited).

get.summary: Live job changes as server-sent events (event 'job': {jobId, status, committed, searchable, updatedAt}).
get.description: Your own jobs, or all with Job.ViewAll. A ': heartbeat' comment every 15 s; the stream ends after at most 30 minutes and EventSource reconnects with Last-Event-ID. Fallback: GET …/jobs?updatedSince=<ISO 8601> every ≥ 5 s.

get.summary: The workspace, the current user's effective permissions in it and its read-only search placement.
get.description: A workspace the user is not a member of returns 404, exactly like one that does not exist.

put.summary: Replace the workspace settings: name, matter number, display time zone and storage profile (If-Match required).

get.summary: Role assignments of the workspace, to users and to IdP groups.
The document's fields with display hints and its artifacts (Document.View).
get.description: Every field the caller may see (system, imported and coding fields) with its canonical value, a display value (instants in the workspace display time zone) and the raw imported string; plus whether text, page images and a native exist. purpose: display (default) or prefetch.

get.summary: The workspace's fields with query names and search capabilities (sortable, filterable, aggregatable, …).
get.description: Every member can read the catalogue: reviewers need it for the grid, the query bar and coding.

post.summary: Create a custom coding or metadata field (Workspace.ManageFields; audited).

get.summary: The coding layouts you may use: sections, field order, required, read-only and conditional fields.
get.description: The default layout first, then the layouts assigned to one of your roles (Workspace Admins see every layout), by name. Fields you may not see are omitted. Field names, types and choices come from GET …/fields.

post.summary: Create a coding layout: sections, field order, required, read-only, conditional and apply-to-family fields, roles (audited).

get.summary: What a new field of each type and storage gets from the search mapping: free slots and capabilities, with limitations in words.
A field with its type attributes, choices, mapping limitations, whether documents hold values, and its ETag.

put.summary: Rename, describe, hide or retype a field (If-Match required; audited). Retyping is refused once documents hold values (409).

delete.summary: Retire a custom field (If-Match required; audited): it leaves every layout and its values are hidden. System fields cannot be retired (409).

post.summary: Add a choice at the end of a choice field (If-Match of the field; audited). Returns the field.

put.summary: Rename, deactivate or reactivate a choice (If-Match of the field; audited). Existing values keep a deactivated choice. Returns the field.

delete.summary: Delete a choice that was never used (If-Match of the field; audited); a used choice can only be deactivated (409). Returns the field.

put.summary: Set the display order of a field's choices; list every choice once (If-Match of the field; audited). Returns the field.

get.summary: A coding layout as the editor sees it: every field, its roles and its ETag.

put.summary: Replace a coding layout (If-Match required; audited). Making it the default unsets the previous default.

delete.summary: Delete a coding layout (If-Match required; audited). The default layout cannot be deleted (409).

get.summary: A document's current coding, by layout, with its version (ETag) and indexing state.
get.description: Lists the coding fields of the layout (every coding field without layoutId) that you may see, with value, editability and last change. projectedVersion reaches documentVersion when search has caught up.

put.summary: Save coding changes with optimistic concurrency (If-Match: the ETag last read).
put.description: All changes apply together or not at all, as one DocumentVersion. 412 version-conflict when the document changed since it was read: the problem carries currentVersion, lastEditor and current (the coding now). Security-affecting fields also need Coding.WritePrivilege. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original result (header Idempotent-Replayed) and writes nothing.

post.summary: Apply coding operations to every document of a frozen set; 202 with the job.
post.description: The set must be a Ready snapshot with purpose BulkCoding (POST …/snapshots). Runs in chunks: each chunk re-checks your access, skips documents whose requested field someone else changed after the set was frozen (Q-07) and documents you can no longer access, and is applied at most once. Security-affecting fields also need Coding.WritePrivilege. Follow the job at Location; outcomes per document at …/bulk-coding/{jobId}/report.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: Per-document outcomes of a bulk coding job, one outcome at a time, cursor-paged.
get.description: outcome=applied (default) lists documents with at least one changed value, by document id; skippedChanged, skippedHidden and failed list the documents left unchanged, in processing order. total is the job's count for the outcome so far.

get.summary: A document's family, duplicates and email thread, as far as you may see them.
get.description: Members you may not see are omitted entirely (never listed or counted). fields=a,b (query names, at most 20 coding fields) adds each member's current values (choices by name). The thread lists its first 200 visible members; total counts them all.

post.summary: Preview copying a document's coding of some fields to its family and/or duplicates.
post.description: Reads the source document's current values of fields and compares them with every related document you may code: targetCount, conflicts (targets already coded differently; the first 100) and mode (job above the threshold, Q-14). Privilege, confidentiality and wall fields need Coding.WritePrivilege. Apply the preview within 10 minutes with POST …/coding-propagations.

post.summary: Apply a coding propagation preview: 200 when applied at once, 202 with the job above the threshold.
post.description: Writes exactly what the preview showed. 409 PREVIEW_STALE when the preview is older than 10 minutes or the source's coding of its fields changed since. Interactive: targets changed since the preview are skipped. Job: a bulk coding job over a frozen set of the targets (Q-07 skip rule); follow it at Location and its outcomes at …/bulk-coding/{jobId}/report. Every change references the source's originating coding event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: The workspace's computed duplicate grouping policy and what its last run did.
get.description: Version 0 means no policy was saved: the default (disabled, auto hash, global scope) applies.

put.summary: Save the computed duplicate grouping policy (If-Match required; "0" before the first save).
put.description: Grouping is family-level: top-level parents are compared on the chosen hash (and, in custodial scope, their custodian) and attachments follow their parent. Documents with an upstream duplicate group are never regrouped. Duplicates are labelled, never hidden. Saving changes no document; POST …/dedupe-runs applies the policy.

post.summary: Apply the saved dedupe policy to every document of the workspace; 202 with the job.
post.description: Re-runnable and idempotent: group ids derive from the hash (and custodian), so an unchanged workspace changes nothing. Documents whose duplicate group or primary flag changes are reindexed; follow the job at Location. A disabled policy removes the computed groups.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: Where the workspace's search projection lives and its recent reindexes.
get.description: Placement facts only (tier, projection generation, revision); physical index names never leave the server.

post.summary: Rebuild the workspace's search projection into a new index; 202 with the job.
post.description: Searches keep working throughout: changes go to both indexes while the new one is filled from the database, it is validated against the database and searches move to it in one alias switch. The previous index stays read-only for the retention period, then is deleted. Cancel the job to abort before the switch. At most one reindex per workspace runs at a time (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

post.summary: Freeze a document set (query, document IDs or another snapshot) and return its frozen count.
post.description: 201 with the Ready snapshot when it was frozen in the request; 202 with Location of the snapshot while a large set materializes. Documents you may not act on for the purpose are never included. Needs Coding.Bulk, Export.Create, Production.Create or Search.Execute (Report), by purpose.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: Frozen sets, newest first: your own, or everyone's with Job.ViewAll.
A snapshot's status, frozen count, generation and verification hash.
Jobs, newest first (or, with updatedSince, in change order): your own, or everyone's with Job.ViewAll.
get.description: Filters: type and status (repeat or comma-separate), createdBy=me|all (all needs Job.ViewAll, else only your own jobs are listed), from/to (creation time, ISO 8601). updatedSince=<ISO 8601> is the polling fallback of the job-events stream: jobs changed after that instant, oldest change first. Timestamps have millisecond precision and a change becomes visible when its transaction commits, so poll with the newest updatedAt seen minus a few seconds; items are state, so a repeated one is harmless.

get.summary: Job detail: committed and searchable progress, chunks by state, attempts, last error and ETA.
get.description: Users always see their own jobs; other users' jobs need Job.ViewAll.

get.summary: Failed chunks and index tasks of the job, and its dead-lettered messages, oldest failure first (PostgreSQL is the failure ledger).

post.summary: Cancel a job: pending chunks are cancelled now, running chunks stop at their next fence (your own jobs, or Job.Manage).
post.description: Committed chunks stay (no undo, Q-34) and their index tasks still run. Repeating the call is harmless.

post.summary: Replay the job's failed chunks and index tasks from PostgreSQL (Job.Replay); idempotent and audited.
post.description: Failed rows return to Pending with their attempts reset and the dispatcher publishes them again; dead-lettered broker messages are never re-published (ADR-010 §7.3). Chunks replay while the job is running, paused or completed with errors; index tasks always (a committed change must reach the index). Fix the cause first.

get.summary: Failed SearchOutbox rows (interactive edits not yet searchable), oldest failure first (Job.ViewAll).

post.summary: Replay every failed SearchOutbox row of the workspace from PostgreSQL (Job.Replay); idempotent and audited.

get.summary: Mapping targets for load-file columns: structural targets first, then system and custom fields.
Saved import profiles of the workspace.

post.summary: Save an import profile. Posting an exported profile copies it into this workspace.

get.summary: An import profile with its ETag; the body is also the profile's JSON export.

put.summary: Replace an import profile (If-Match required).

post.summary: Parse the first rows of a DAT with a profile, auto-map columns and show coerced values with per-column error counts.
Start an import: upload the DAT (and/or an OPT) with a saved or ad-hoc import profile; 202 with the import and its job.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: Imports of the workspace, newest first, with their report counters and job progress.

post.summary: Pre-flight an import: check the load file, mapping, rows, workspace collisions and file paths without loading anything.
post.description: Same multipart body as starting an import. 200 with error/warning counts and the first 200 issues; all issues download as CSV from …/imports/preflight/{preflightId}/issues for 48 hours (creator only).

get.summary: One import with its report (read / imported / overlaid / skipped / errored) and job progress.
Row-level errors (and warnings with includeWarnings=true) of an import, DAT rows then OPT rows, in row order.
Family report of an import: orphan attachments, range gaps, documents claimed by two families, invalid ranges, cycles.
The pages of the document's active page set (Document.View).
get.description: Page geometry (points), rotation and which review image and thumbnail can be fetched, in page order. limit: 1-500 (default 500). purpose: display (default) or prefetch.

get.summary: One fixed-size chunk of the extracted text (Document.View).
get.description: Chunk n covers the characters that start in bytes [n * chunkSizeBytes, (n + 1) * chunkSizeBytes) of the stored UTF-8 text, so chunks never split a character and concatenate to the whole text. A document without text answers chunk 0 with missing: true. purpose: display (default) or prefetch.

get.summary: Term hits in the extracted text: the current search's and Highlight Sets' (Document.View).
get.description: Server-computed hit spans over the stored text, a page of whole chunks at a time (up to 16 chunks or about 5,000 hits): chunk-local UTF-16 offsets per hit and per-unit counts for the page; ask again with fromChunk = nextChunk until it is null. searchId: the caller's search handle (its terms, phrases, wildcards and W/n proximities, each phrase and proximity as one span; NOT clauses and other fields are not highlighted); an expired or unknown handle answers 404 (run the search again). highlightSetId (repeatable, at most 20; an unknown one answers 404): Highlight Sets to apply. Audited like a text retrieval; no text is returned.

get.summary: Download the native file (Document.DownloadNative).
get.description: Always an attachment of type application/octet-stream. Streamed with single-range support, or a 303 to a 60-second, single-object presigned URL when the installation enables presigned native delivery.

get.summary: The document's extracted text (Document.View).
get.description: purpose: display (default) or prefetch. Prefetch is audited as such and never counts as viewed.

get.summary: A review image of a page of the active page set (Document.View; Document.Print with purpose=print).
get.description: purpose: display (default), prefetch or print.

get.summary: A thumbnail of a page of the active page set (Document.View).
get.description: purpose: display (default) or prefetch.

post.summary: Record that the viewer displayed the document (Document.Viewed).
post.description: Re-checks Document.View. Send the X-Opportunity-Retrieval-Id of the response that was displayed.

post.summary: Export a frozen set to a load-file volume (Export.Create); 202 with the export and its job.
post.description: The volume holds a DAT with the listed fields in order (and native/text path columns), natives, extracted text and page images with an OPT, a manifest with the SHA-256 of every file, and an exclusion report: every document is re-authorized for you when its chunk runs, and documents you can no longer access are left out (Q-15).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: Exports, newest first: your own, or everyone's with Job.ViewAll.
One export with its settings, report (counts, manifest SHA-256) and job progress.
Documents left out because you could no longer access them when their chunk ran (Q-15), in volume order.
The delivered files of a completed export, in path order, with size and SHA-256 (Export.Download, your own exports).

post.summary: Create a draft production of a frozen set, a saved search (frozen now) or as the next version of a finalized production.
post.description: The specification is validated and stored with every default filled in (canonical JSON and its SHA-256). A Bates start number inside a range another production of the same prefix holds is refused (409).

get.summary: Productions of the workspace, newest first.
Bates cross-reference: the document behind a Bates number (?number=ABC0000123), or a document's numbers (?documentId=).
get.description: Searches produced, voided and allocated draft productions; discarded drafts' numbers were never issued. Documents you may not view are only counted.

get.summary: One production with its specification, Bates range, integrity check, manifest and ETag.

put.summary: Replace a draft's specification, name or frozen set (If-Match required). Releases any Bates allocation; finalized productions never change (409).

post.summary: Allocate the draft's Bates numbers (202 with the job): production order keeps families together; placeholders and slip sheets take one number.
post.description: The range is reserved only if it overlaps no other production's numbers of the same prefix; after the job an integrity check (no duplicates in the matter, no unattributed gaps, families adjacent) decides whether the allocation stands.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

post.summary: Finalize an allocated draft (If-Match required): specification, membership and Bates numbers are frozen and recorded in the manifest.
Void a finalized production with a reason (If-Match required); its Bates numbers are never issued again.
Discard a draft (If-Match required); its never-produced Bates numbers become free again (Q-54).

get.summary: The production's documents in production order with ProdBegBates, ProdEndBates, ProdBegAttach and ProdEndAttach.

post.summary: Re-verify the production against its manifest: specification, frozen set and a re-run of the Bates allocation; differences are listed and audited.

get.summary: Download one file of a completed export (Export.Download, your own exports).
get.description: Always an attachment of type application/octet-stream; a single byte range is supported.

get.summary: Download a completed export as one ZIP: manifest, exclusion report and the volume (Export.Download, your own exports).
get.description: Streamed; entries are stored uncompressed under their package paths (ZIP64). Use the file downloads to resume.

get.summary: The import summary report: rows, natives/text, images/pages, families, elapsed and issue counts (frozen when the import finishes).
The import summary report as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM): one Section,Metric,Value line per figure.
The re-loadable error file: the DAT header plus ImportError, then every row not loaded, byte for byte in the source's delimiters and encoding.
get.description: Fix the rows and load the file again unchanged: the ImportError column is never loaded. 409 for an OPT-only load (no DAT).

get.summary: Every issue of a pre-flight as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM), in row order; kept 48 hours, for the user who ran it only.

post.summary: Count named terms over the workspace, a saved search or a snapshot; 202 with the report and its job.
post.description: Give terms as [{name, expression}] or as termsCsv (Name,Expression lines). The report runs as a background job over a materialized snapshot of the scope: per term documents with hits, with family, unique hits and unique hits with family, plus totals. A term that does not parse or bind gets a per-term error and the report still runs. Counts exclude documents the person running the report may not see.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: Search term reports, newest first: your own, or everyone's with Job.ViewAll.
One search term report with its provenance (snapshot, search generation, index current), terms, counts and job.

delete.summary: Delete a report (its creator or a workspace admin); a run in progress is cancelled. Audited.

post.summary: Run a completed or failed report again over the same snapshot (its creator or a workspace admin); 202.
post.description: The same snapshot and terms give the same numbers while the documents and access rights are unchanged.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-chosen key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original response.

get.summary: The completed report as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM) or XLSX: provenance, one row per term, totals. Audited.
The signed-in user's UI preferences, by key.

put.summary: Store one preference value (any JSON except null, at most 16 KiB).
put.description: Keys start with a letter and use letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' (at most 100 characters); at most 100 keys per user.

delete.summary: Remove one preference, restoring the default.
